integrity: Analytic infinite-frequency argument and exact rational certificates are provided. Finite numerical probes are consistency tests only; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only integer Fourier modes of the equal-weight middle-thirds Cantor probability measure are classified at the first two nonzero absolute levels. The third level and the rest of the spectrum are not determined. Older spectral literature, including Sarnak (1980), was not accessible in complete text for exclusion of an equivalent formulation.
title: The two leading integer Fourier multiplier moduli of the middle-thirds Cantor measure
